title: Original-data rigidity at equality in spacetime Penrose bounds
exact_target: For each $n\geq 3$ and the smooth DEC one-ended enclosing-area exterior class with connected nondegenerate outermost outer-minimizing horizon specified in the manuscript, does equality in the neutral spacetime Penrose bound imply a global spacelike embedding of the entire original exterior, including boundary, into the corresponding Schwarzschild–Tangherlini exterior and future horizon? Require the given metric and second fundamental form to be induced exactly, a future normal smooth up to the boundary, and the chosen end approaching spatial infinity.
